_readme: Copy this file to breeze.config.json and fill in your own OAuth client ids. GitHub: create an OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers and tick 'Enable Device Flow' (no secret needed). Google: create a 'Desktop app' OAuth client at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials (its secret is not confidential for desktop apps). Discord presence: create an application at https://discord.com/developers/applications and paste its Application ID (optionally add a Rich Presence art asset named 'breeze'). Environment variables BREEZE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, BREEZE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and BREEZE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET override this file; you can also put them in a .env file next to main.js (keep secrets there, never commit them).
